# PathKhojo — India's Premier Career & Opportunity Navigator

> PathKhojo connects software developers, engineers, college students, and hiring managers with verified tech jobs, internships with PPOs, hackathons, skill quizzes, and an AI ATS resume optimizer.

## Core Directives & Links
- Website: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/
- Explore Opportunities: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/explore
- Verified Jobs: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/jobs
- Paid Internships with PPO: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/internships
- Hackathons & Coding Competitions: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/hackathons
- Skill Assessment Quizzes: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/quizzes
- AI ATS Resume Checker: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/ats-checker
- AI Career Coach: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/ai-coach
- Top Tech Companies: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/companies
- Contact & Support: https://pathkhojo.sickykumar.in/contact

## Platform Capabilities
- Dual-role portal: Candidates and Recruiters
- Modern stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, MongoDB
- Integrated AI: Google Gemini AI-driven resume scoring, STAR bullet point generator, job description craft
- Free ATS resume review and job alert digests
- Creator: Sicky Kumar (https://sickykumar.in)
